sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8552 of 2020

Applicant :- Pankaj
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhakar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anil Kumar,G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.
1.

Applicant-Pankaj has approached this Court by way of filing present bail application seeking
enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 243 of 2019, under Sections 304B, 498A, 323 Ipc and 3/4
Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Jalalabad, District Shahjahanpur.
2.  This application is pending for about four years.
Sri Sudhakar Yadav, learned counsel for applicant is not present.

3. In pursuance of an order passed by this Court, Trial Court concerned has submitted a report dated 18.10.2023 that trial in present case has already been concluded and judgment was pronounced way back on 07.04.2021, whereby applicant has been acquitted.

Pankaj vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166036708/
1
4. Learned counsel for applicant was not diligent to brought aforesaid fact before this Court which led to unnecessary increase in pendency of bail applications.

5. In aforesaid circumstances, taking note of subsequent events this application is disposed of.
